title: You're NOT Using a Job Tracker? | Organizing Your Job Search the RIGHT Way
description:
There are way too many parts of a job search to keep everything in your head so using a job tracker is absolutely essential to staying organized. Today, our founder David Fano is going to walk you through an overview of our Teal Job Tracker and talk a bit about the principles behind an organized search.

To learn more and download the free Chrome extension, head to: www.tealhq.com
